verdict.rationale: Unit's docs say transaction data is exposed through APIs and webhooks, with real-time balances and 'settlement-level transaction visibility' across ACH, wires, real-time payments, checks and cards. That loosely suggests some rail-level metadata, but nothing describes the transaction data model itself. missing for 10: documented counterparty fields, specific rail metadata (e.g., ACH addenda or wire references), stable transaction identifiers, merchant/category enrichment, a published API schema (the OpenAPI probes returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
